overall_reason: A billing card ('Starter plan', '$24 / month', '3 of 5 seats') where every row is boxed in the same blue border, so no fact leads.

score.reason: T-BOLD-MOVE fails (four bordered boxes of equal weight inside a bordered card), T-MIRROR and T-RIVAL-NAME hold for any SaaS plan card, and T-SIGNATURE fails because seat use is the smallest text.

findings.title: Spend boldness in one place
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the plan name, price and seat row each sit in their own blue-bordered box inside a blue-bordered card, and the button repeats the same blue.
findings.before: Four framed boxes plus a framed card, all in one blue.
findings.after: Remove the inner boxes; let the price be the one large element and separate rows with space.
findings.why: When every row is framed equally, the reader cannot tell what matters.

findings.title: One real signature on the first screen
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png '3 of 5 seats' is set at about 10 px, the smallest text in the card, although seat use is the fact that decides whether to manage the plan.
findings.before: Seat use in the smallest type.
findings.after: Show seat use as the working object, for example '3 of 5 seats used' with a short meter.
findings.why: The fact that drives the card's only action is the hardest to read.

findings.title: No look picked for the category or by default
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png headings, price, labels, borders, badge and button all use the same mid blue on pale blue.
findings.before: A single blue applied to every element.
findings.after: Set text in neutral ink and keep blue for the action and the 'Active' badge.
findings.why: A one-hue card reads as a framework default, not as this product.

strengths: The content is the right content for the job: plan, price, seat use and one 'Manage plan' action.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
Motion and state changes: one static frame per width only.
